title: Watermark Claims Under Test: Lessons from Auditing a Production LLM
abstract: arXiv:2611.29018v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Can we tell whether an LLM is watermarked without knowing its secret key? Published black-box tests suggest that carefully designed prompts can reveal the statistical footprint of a watermark. This paper examines what happens when those tests move from controlled reference implementations to a deployed model whose watermarking parameters are undisclosed. We present an audit of the Red-Green watermark presence test on Claude. Across ten initial configurations, the published test never rejects on a model the provider states is watermarked, despite detecting a local reference at comparable sample sizes. Controlled experiments expose a failure mode: including the prompt in the watermark's repeated-context history suppresses marking exactly where the test measures it. The watermark remains active, but the probe becomes blind. Attempts to repair the probe reveal further confounds. Constructed contexts can trigger native digit-to-word prefere

translated_title: 水印声明接受检验：审计生产级大语言模型的经验教训
translated_abstract: 我们能否在不知道LLM密钥的情况下判断其是否带有水印？已发表的黑盒测试表明，精心设计的提示词可以揭示水印的统计足迹。本文考察了当这些测试从受控的参考实现转移到水印参数未公开的已部署模型时会发生什么。我们对Claude上的红绿水印存在性检验进行了审计。在十种初始配置中，该已发表的检验在供应商声明已加水印的模型上从未产生拒绝结果，尽管在可比样本量下它能检测到本地参考实现。受控实验揭示了一种失效模式：将提示词纳入水印的重复上下文历史中，恰好会在检验所测量的位置抑制水印标记。水印仍然处于激活状态，但探针变得“失明”。修复探针的尝试揭示了更多的混淆因素：构造的上下文可能触发模型原生的数字转单词偏好转换……（摘要截断）
tldr: 对生产级LLM的红绿水印黑盒检测审计表明，已发表的黑盒测试在真实部署的水印模型上会失效，因为提示词被纳入水印的重复上下文历史后会恰好抑制检验所测量的标记，导致探针“失明”。
en_tdlr: An audit of the Red-Green watermark test on a production LLM shows that published black-box probes fail on deployed watermarked models, because including the prompt in the watermark's repeated-context history suppresses marking exactly where the test measures it, rendering the probe blind.
